content_sections.heading: South Indian Bank Head - Risk Control Unit Job Description
content_sections.text: As per the notification, the role includes the following responSouth Indian Bankilities: Pre-disbursement Risk Assessment: Ensuring all loan applications are scrutinized to identify potential credit, fraud and operational risks, and verifying customer credentials, documents and transaction patterns. Document Verification: Ensuring and validating all loan documents such as KYC, income proofs, collateral documents and supporting records, and identifying forged, altered or inconsistent documentation. Fraud Risk Analysis: Detecting early warning signals (EWS) and suspicious activities, and analyzing fraud typologies, modus operandi and emerging risk trends. Field Investigation and CPV Review: Reviewing customer point verification (CPV), residence and workplace checks, and assessing third-party investigation reports and vendor findings. Vendor and DSA Risk Monitoring: Monitoring the sourcing quality of DSAs, agents and vendors, and flagging abnormal sourcing patterns, deviations or policy breaches. Policy and Regulatory Compliance: Ensuring adherence to internal credit policies and regulatory guidelines (RBI, AML, KYC), and identifying and reporting deviations for corrective action. Exception Handling and Escalation: Escalating critical risks to senior management or committees. Post-Disbursement Review and Monitoring: Conducting sample audits and back-checks of disbursed accounts, and monitoring portfolio quality and early delinquency indicators. MIS and Reporting: Preparing periodic MIS on risk trends, fraud cases and control gaps, and supporting audits, inspections and management reviews. Coordination and Stakeholder Engagement: Liaising with credit, operations, legal, compliance and investigation teams, and supporting training and awareness on risk controls and fraud prevention. Continuous Improvement: Suggesting enhancements to risk frameworks, controls and checklists, and participating in process reviews and automation initiatives. Leadership: Ability to lead and nurture a team. Team management Deep knowledge of risk frameworks, controls, etc. Knowledge of various MIS and reporting tools Data and analytical skills Experience in detecting early warning signals (EWS) and suspicious activities, and in analyzing fraud typologies, modus operandi, etc.
